note: One plain rewrite per requirement, shown after "Done when:". Each was checked against its requirement (same requirement, not weaker, not stricter, nothing dropped), then re-checked by a separate reviewer (24 Nov 2026). sentence_hash is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the requirement sentence it rewrites: when the rubric changes that sentence, the line is not used until it is rewritten and checked again.

AIQIF-C1.1.F1.done_when: an approved plan for your institution names a digital or AI priority.

AIQIF-C1.1.F2.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for that priority.

AIQIF-C1.1.A1.done_when: records show an AI initiative actually running in a named area of your institution's work.

AIQIF-C1.1.A2.done_when: a review of your set of initiatives records a decision about an AI initiative.

AIQIF-C1.1.O1.done_when: a completed review of your set of initiatives compares a measured result with the objective stated for it.

AIQIF-C1.1.O2.done_when: a later record evaluates what effect a decision from such a review had.

AIQIF-C1.2.F1.done_when: a named body in your institution has authority over the relevant digital or AI decisions.

AIQIF-C1.2.F2.done_when: there is a set route for escalating those decisions to a higher level.

AIQIF-C1.2.A1.done_when: a dated decision by a governing body concerns an AI use that is actually in place.

AIQIF-C1.2.A2.done_when: an action assigned by a governing body has a recorded follow-up.

AIQIF-C1.2.O1.done_when: a review evaluates how well governance is working, using a named incident or a named delivery result.

AIQIF-C1.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up checks whether a revised governance rule has been put into practice.

AIQIF-C1.3.F1.done_when: a commitment of resources, such as funds, staff or equipment, supports computing, teaching or innovation capacity relevant to digital or AI work.

AIQIF-C1.3.F2.done_when: the decision to allocate it names the group or function it is meant to benefit.

AIQIF-C1.3.A1.done_when: a review compares the resources committed with a named need they are meant to meet.

AIQIF-C1.3.A2.done_when: a decision about resources responds to a recorded shortfall in capacity.

AIQIF-C1.3.O1.done_when: a completed review compares a stated cost with a measured benefit or capacity result.

AIQIF-C1.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change in how resources are allocated had.

AIQIF-C1.4.F1.done_when: you have a set process for introducing a digital service or teaching tool.

AIQIF-C1.4.F2.done_when: users of that service or tool have a named contact for help.

AIQIF-C1.4.A1.done_when: usage records show the service or tool being used repeatedly within the named group or setting it was introduced to.

AIQIF-C1.4.A2.done_when: a support action responds to a recorded obstacle to people taking it up.

AIQIF-C1.4.O1.done_when: a completed review compares how far it has been taken up with a clearly stated target.

AIQIF-C1.4.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates a change in how the service or tool is taken up, or in users' experience of it.

AIQIF-C2.1.F1.done_when: guidance in force at your institution deals with AI use explicitly.

AIQIF-C2.1.F2.done_when: that guidance sets a limit on unsafe or inappropriate use of AI.

AIQIF-C2.1.A1.done_when: a check made when an AI tool is introduced, or when a user is set up, applies a requirement of the AI policy.

AIQIF-C2.1.A2.done_when: a review of a sample of AI use records how an exception to the policy was dealt with.

AIQIF-C2.1.O1.done_when: a review of the policy evaluates a named incident or a named finding from a check or audit.

AIQIF-C2.1.O2.done_when: a follow-up tests what effect a revised safeguard on responsible AI use had.

AIQIF-C2.2.F1.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for personal or sensitive data your institution holds.

AIQIF-C2.2.F2.done_when: the information system concerned is covered by a procedure for controlling who can access it.

AIQIF-C2.2.A1.done_when: a risk assessment covers a named use that is in place.

AIQIF-C2.2.A2.done_when: a recorded decision about risk responds to a named change in access or in a supplier.

AIQIF-C2.2.O1.done_when: a completed risk review compares the level of risk with a stated risk criterion.

AIQIF-C2.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up tests whether a fix that was put in place works.

AIQIF-C2.3.F1.done_when: a list names the AI services in use in the part of your institution being assessed.

AIQIF-C2.3.F2.done_when: each service on that list has a person or office made responsible for it.

AIQIF-C2.3.A1.done_when: an evaluation record concerns an AI service that was actually released or changed.

AIQIF-C2.3.A2.done_when: a record of the change says where that service's data came from.

AIQIF-C2.3.O1.done_when: monitoring after a release compares how the service actually behaves with a stated evaluation criterion.

AIQIF-C2.3.O2.done_when: an exercise in rolling back or retiring a service records the result observed.

AIQIF-C2.4.F1.done_when: for a named AI use with significant consequences for people, there is a set way for a person to step in.

AIQIF-C2.4.F2.done_when: people affected by that use have a way to report errors or to appeal.

AIQIF-C2.4.A1.done_when: a record shows a person overseeing an AI use with significant consequences that is actually in place.

AIQIF-C2.4.A2.done_when: a test examines a specific failure risk or fairness risk in that use.

AIQIF-C2.4.O1.done_when: a reviewer who was not part of the decision to deliver that use evaluates a named harm or oversight result.

AIQIF-C2.4.O2.done_when: a follow-up tests what effect a change to oversight had.

AIQIF-C3.1.F1.done_when: an approved syllabus includes real AI or machine-learning content, not a passing mention.

AIQIF-C3.1.F2.done_when: a clearly stated learning objective covers that AI or machine-learning content.

AIQIF-C3.1.A1.done_when: teaching records show real AI content being taught to a named programme group.

AIQIF-C3.1.A2.done_when: marked student work shows what students achieved against a clearly stated AI learning criterion.

AIQIF-C3.1.O1.done_when: a completed course review compares what students achieved in AI learning with a stated objective.

AIQIF-C3.1.O2.done_when: a later assessment evaluates what effect a change to the curriculum had.

AIQIF-C3.2.F1.done_when: a learning offer in AI literacy (understanding and using AI) is set out.

AIQIF-C3.2.F2.done_when: a way of delivering that offer makes it available to a named group of learners.

AIQIF-C3.2.A1.done_when: delivery records show an AI literacy activity for a named discipline.

AIQIF-C3.2.A2.done_when: a support measure addresses a recorded gap in access or learning specific to one discipline.

AIQIF-C3.2.O1.done_when: an assessment reports AI literacy attainment for a named discipline.

AIQIF-C3.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up assessment evaluates what effect targeted literacy support had.

AIQIF-C3.3.F1.done_when: a course design sets out a learning or feedback activity supported by AI.

AIQIF-C3.3.F2.done_when: instructions to learners say what use of AI is acceptable in that activity.

AIQIF-C3.3.A1.done_when: course records show a named AI-supported learning activity being used repeatedly.

AIQIF-C3.3.A2.done_when: a check in assessment evaluates whether learners depend on AI inappropriately in that activity.

AIQIF-C3.3.O1.done_when: a completed evaluation compares learning or feedback results with a stated baseline.

AIQIF-C3.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the design of that AI-supported learning had.

AIQIF-C3.4.F1.done_when: a student project or lab option includes real AI work, not a passing mention.

AIQIF-C3.4.F2.done_when: mentoring is provided for that work.

AIQIF-C3.4.A1.done_when: marked project work shows a working AI application built by a named student group.

AIQIF-C3.4.A2.done_when: a moderation record (a second check on marking) checks each student's own contribution to that work.

AIQIF-C3.4.O1.done_when: a completed review of projects evaluates the work against a clearly stated criterion for the abilities shown.

AIQIF-C3.4.O2.done_when: after a change to mentoring or project design, later work is evaluated against a comparable criterion.

AIQIF-C4.1.F1.done_when: a learning activity for faculty, focused on AI, has set content.

AIQIF-C4.1.F2.done_when: participation in an AI-focused learning activity is recorded for a named faculty group.

AIQIF-C4.1.A1.done_when: an assessment shows the AI literacy of a named faculty group.

AIQIF-C4.1.A2.done_when: a support measure addresses a recorded gap in faculty AI literacy.

AIQIF-C4.1.O1.done_when: a completed assessment compares faculty AI literacy with a stated standard of competence.

AIQIF-C4.1.O2.done_when: a follow-up assessment evaluates what effect a change to faculty learning had.

AIQIF-C4.2.F1.done_when: an AI learning offer for faculty is aimed at a named academic role.

AIQIF-C4.2.F2.done_when: a practice task builds a specific AI-related academic skill for that role.

AIQIF-C4.2.A1.done_when: an assessed task relevant to the role shows a faculty AI skill.

AIQIF-C4.2.A2.done_when: a support action addresses a recorded skill gap specific to the role.

AIQIF-C4.2.O1.done_when: a sample of academic work shows the assessed skill being applied.

AIQIF-C4.2.O2.done_when: a later evaluation of tasks tests what effect a change to the role's learning pathway had.

AIQIF-C4.3.F1.done_when: a record of faculty work shows AI being used in an academic task.

AIQIF-C4.3.F2.done_when: a step where a person reviews the AI-supported task is set out.

AIQIF-C4.3.A1.done_when: samples of work show AI being used repeatedly in a named faculty practice.

AIQIF-C4.3.A2.done_when: a quality check evaluates the AI-supported academic work.

AIQIF-C4.3.O1.done_when: a completed evaluation compares a result in academic quality, time taken or research with a stated baseline.

AIQIF-C4.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates a change in practice made in response to a named failure.

AIQIF-C4.4.F1.done_when: a learning offer on digital tools or ways of working is aimed at a named non-teaching staff role.

AIQIF-C4.4.F2.done_when: staff applying that learning have somewhere to go for support.

AIQIF-C4.4.A1.done_when: an assessed task shows a relevant digital or AI skill for a named staff role.

AIQIF-C4.4.A2.done_when: a support action addresses a recorded error in how staff carry out their work.

AIQIF-C4.4.O1.done_when: a completed evaluation compares how staff performed tasks with a stated standard for the role.

AIQIF-C4.4.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to staff training or support had.

AIQIF-C5.1.F1.done_when: an AI literacy offer is open to a named group of students.

AIQIF-C5.1.F2.done_when: a learning objective sets out what that offer intends students to learn.

AIQIF-C5.1.A1.done_when: delivery records show AI literacy teaching given to a named group of students.

AIQIF-C5.1.A2.done_when: a support measure addresses a recorded gap in participation or attainment.

AIQIF-C5.1.O1.done_when: an assessment reports students' AI literacy attainment against a clearly stated criterion.

AIQIF-C5.1.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change made to close an access or learning gap had.

AIQIF-C5.2.F1.done_when: an advanced AI or machine-learning skills pathway is set out for a named group of students.

AIQIF-C5.2.F2.done_when: the pathway includes a practical assessed task.

AIQIF-C5.2.A1.done_when: student work shows an advanced or job-specific AI skill, judged against a clearly stated criterion.

AIQIF-C5.2.A2.done_when: a change in how the pathway is delivered responds to specific feedback from employers or from experts in the subject.

AIQIF-C5.2.O1.done_when: a completed review of the pathway evaluates a relevant result in skills or in students' progression.

AIQIF-C5.2.O2.done_when: a later evaluation of tasks tests what effect a change to the pathway had.

AIQIF-C5.3.F1.done_when: an AI project or portfolio opportunity is open to a named group of students.

AIQIF-C5.3.F2.done_when: an assessment criterion covers each student's own contribution to the project or portfolio.

AIQIF-C5.3.A1.done_when: a reviewed portfolio identifies the student's own real AI contribution.

AIQIF-C5.3.A2.done_when: a moderation record (a second check on marking) evaluates a participating student's project or portfolio.

AIQIF-C5.3.O1.done_when: a completed evaluation judges the quality of the AI work, or its value to real users, against a clearly stated criterion.

AIQIF-C5.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to projects or mentoring had.

AIQIF-C5.4.F1.done_when: an internship or career opportunity relevant to AI is recorded.

AIQIF-C5.4.F2.done_when: an eligibility rule says who can take up the opportunity.

AIQIF-C5.4.A1.done_when: a verified record shows participation in an AI-relevant internship or career opportunity.

AIQIF-C5.4.A2.done_when: a register of the group of students gives the total against which participation or progression is counted.

AIQIF-C5.4.O1.done_when: a completed review compares a verified AI-related career result with a stated target.

AIQIF-C5.4.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to a career pathway had.

AIQIF-C6.1.F1.done_when: the learners or researchers concerned have access to computing resources.

AIQIF-C6.1.F2.done_when: the specifications of those resources support one clearly named introductory AI workload.

AIQIF-C6.1.A1.done_when: usage records show the computing capacity concerned serving a named group of users.

AIQIF-C6.1.A2.done_when: a support measure addresses a recorded failure of capacity or access.

AIQIF-C6.1.O1.done_when: a completed review compares how the service performed with a stated target for capacity or availability.

AIQIF-C6.1.O2.done_when: a continuity exercise records how well that computing environment recovered.

AIQIF-C6.2.F1.done_when: a register lists the relevant datasets or systems your institution holds.

AIQIF-C6.2.F2.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for looking after the listed datasets or systems.

AIQIF-C6.2.A1.done_when: a data-quality check runs for a named AI use or for an activity preparing for one.

AIQIF-C6.2.A2.done_when: a data-quality problem that was logged has a recorded outcome.

AIQIF-C6.2.O1.done_when: a completed review compares data quality with a stated standard for being fit for use.

AIQIF-C6.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up measures what effect a change to data quality had on the work that uses the data.

AIQIF-C6.3.F1.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for the security of the computing environment concerned.

AIQIF-C6.3.F2.done_when: a recovery procedure covers that environment.

AIQIF-C6.3.A1.done_when: a security test examines a named AI-related threat in that environment.

AIQIF-C6.3.A2.done_when: a record of an incident or an exercise shows an action taken in response.

AIQIF-C6.3.O1.done_when: a completed security review compares how well problems were fixed, or how well systems recovered, with a stated criterion.

AIQIF-C6.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up test evaluates a change to security controls made in response to a recorded threat.

AIQIF-C6.4.F1.done_when: a learning environment supports one named introductory AI learning activity.

AIQIF-C6.4.F2.done_when: learners have a set way of getting access to that environment.

AIQIF-C6.4.A1.done_when: usage records show learners getting access to a named AI learning environment.

AIQIF-C6.4.A2.done_when: a support measure addresses a recorded problem with accessibility or capacity.

AIQIF-C6.4.O1.done_when: a completed review compares learners' access with a stated standard for the service or for fair access.

AIQIF-C6.4.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect an improvement to the environment had.

AIQIF-C7.1.F1.done_when: an AI research or applied investigation project has a set objective.

AIQIF-C7.1.F2.done_when: a person is made responsible for leading the project.

AIQIF-C7.1.A1.done_when: an active AI research or applied investigation project has an output that has been reviewed.

AIQIF-C7.1.A2.done_when: a progress review records a decision about that project.

AIQIF-C7.1.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates the quality or use of the project's output against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C7.1.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the research agenda or its resources had.

AIQIF-C7.2.F1.done_when: an AI centre, or an innovation function spread across your institution, has a set remit.

AIQIF-C7.2.F2.done_when: a project or mentoring service is available through it.

AIQIF-C7.2.A1.done_when: a record of its services shows an AI project or an AI mentoring engagement that it took on.

AIQIF-C7.2.A2.done_when: a review of the service records a decision made in response to evidence about its use or delivery.

AIQIF-C7.2.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates an output or a benefit to the institution against the function's objective.

AIQIF-C7.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the service had.

AIQIF-C7.3.F1.done_when: support for funding, intellectual property or incubation is available to eligible projects.

AIQIF-C7.3.F2.done_when: a contact or an application process gives access to that support.

AIQIF-C7.3.A1.done_when: a project record shows that support for funding, intellectual property or incubation was used.

AIQIF-C7.3.A2.done_when: a review records a decision about funding a named project or taking it into practical use.

AIQIF-C7.3.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates a project's verified progress against a stated milestone.

AIQIF-C7.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to project support had.

AIQIF-C7.4.F1.done_when: a work plan for a collaboration sets out real AI research or application work, not a passing mention.

AIQIF-C7.4.F2.done_when: a partner is given responsibility for the planned AI work.

AIQIF-C7.4.A1.done_when: a record shows real AI work done with a partner, beyond signing an agreement.

AIQIF-C7.4.A2.done_when: feedback from a partner or from those who benefited evaluates a named contribution that was delivered.

AIQIF-C7.4.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates the knowledge passed on, or a result for those who benefited, against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C7.4.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the collaboration had.

AIQIF-C8.1.F1.done_when: a digital service your institution runs has a set purpose.

AIQIF-C8.1.F2.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for that service.

AIQIF-C8.1.A1.done_when: operating records show AI being used repeatedly in a named service of your institution.

AIQIF-C8.1.A2.done_when: a monitoring record evaluates a problem or unusual event in the service that involved AI.

AIQIF-C8.1.O1.done_when: a completed evaluation compares the service's benefit with a stated baseline and says openly what limits the quality of that comparison.

AIQIF-C8.1.O2.done_when: a follow-up tests what effect a change to the workflow or its controls had.

AIQIF-C8.2.F1.done_when: a work plan with industry sets out an AI-related activity.

AIQIF-C8.2.F2.done_when: the activity sets out what it will contribute to skills, the curriculum or projects.

AIQIF-C8.2.A1.done_when: a record shows an AI-related activity carried out with an industry partner.

AIQIF-C8.2.A2.done_when: a review evaluates what the partner actually contributed to skills, projects or opportunities.

AIQIF-C8.2.O1.done_when: a completed review of the partnership evaluates a relevant output or outcome against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C8.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change in delivery, agreed jointly with the partner, had.

AIQIF-C8.3.F1.done_when: a pathway into employment, enterprise or the workforce deals with AI skills explicitly.

AIQIF-C8.3.F2.done_when: an opportunity or referral process connects eligible participants to the pathway.

AIQIF-C8.3.A1.done_when: a verified record links someone on the AI pathway to an opportunity or a venture.

AIQIF-C8.3.A2.done_when: a review examines how taking part in the pathway relates to a result that was observed.

AIQIF-C8.3.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates a verified progression or enterprise result against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C8.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the set of pathways had.

AIQIF-C8.4.F1.done_when: a named AI initiative has a clearly stated intended outcome.

AIQIF-C8.4.F2.done_when: a method for measuring that outcome is set out before the outcome is measured.

AIQIF-C8.4.A1.done_when: recorded results compare the AI initiative's outcome with a stated baseline, using a method that is set out.

AIQIF-C8.4.A2.done_when: a review examines another possible explanation, or a possible harm, that affects how the results should be read.

AIQIF-C8.4.O1.done_when: a completed review of the measurements evaluates the benefit and clearly states the limits of what it can conclude.

AIQIF-C8.4.O2.done_when: a later measurement evaluates what effect a change to the initiative had.

AIQIF-C9.1.F1.done_when: a review process run by your institution uses set indicators.

AIQIF-C9.1.F2.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for producing that indicator-based review.

AIQIF-C9.1.A1.done_when: an institutional assessment carried out more than once uses evidence that can be traced to its source, with calculations that can be repeated.

AIQIF-C9.1.A2.done_when: a record of changes separates changes in the institution's evidence from changes in how it is measured.

AIQIF-C9.1.O1.done_when: a completed review uses the assessment's results to evaluate an improvement priority.

AIQIF-C9.1.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the measurement method had.

AIQIF-C9.2.F1.done_when: an index of evidence lists the source records used for assessment.

AIQIF-C9.2.F2.done_when: a person or office is made responsible for keeping those records.

AIQIF-C9.2.A1.done_when: a finding picked from an assessment can be traced back to the requirement it answers and the passage it rests on.

AIQIF-C9.2.A2.done_when: when evidence is corrected, the earlier record and the reason for the change are kept.

AIQIF-C9.2.O1.done_when: a completed audit evaluates how well findings can be traced, following a clearly set out checking procedure.

AIQIF-C9.2.O2.done_when: a follow-up measures what effect an improvement to the evidence process had.

AIQIF-C9.3.F1.done_when: a process keeps track of relevant changes in accreditation, curriculum or technology.

AIQIF-C9.3.F2.done_when: a review schedule sets when those changes are considered.

AIQIF-C9.3.A1.done_when: a review of changes names a requirement affected by a change from outside the institution.

AIQIF-C9.3.A2.done_when: a new version of an assessment keeps the earlier result and explains what changed.

AIQIF-C9.3.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates how promptly a relevant change was picked up.

AIQIF-C9.3.O2.done_when: a follow-up evaluates what effect a change to the monitoring process had.

AIQIF-C9.4.F1.done_when: a process for gathering feedback covers a digital or learning initiative of your institution.

AIQIF-C9.4.F2.done_when: a register of follow-up actions names who owns the actions that result.

AIQIF-C9.4.A1.done_when: a review of whether users accept a named initiative that is in use, or of its outcomes, evaluates that initiative.

AIQIF-C9.4.A2.done_when: a corrective action has a recorded check that it was completed.

AIQIF-C9.4.O1.done_when: a completed review evaluates what resulted from a change made in response to feedback.

AIQIF-C9.4.O2.done_when: a later initiative can be shown to apply a lesson from that review.
